Common questions

Things business owners ask us

How soon will I see enquiries?

Google Ads can bring enquiries within days of launch. The first weeks are for learning and refining, so results usually improve over the first month or two.

Is the ad budget separate from your charges?

Yes. Your ad budget is paid directly to Google from your own card, so you always see exactly what was spent. Our charges depend on your goals and budget, and we share a clear quote after the free audit.

How much should I spend on Google Ads?

It depends on your industry, city and how much a customer is worth to you. After the audit we recommend a starting budget that’s enough to learn properly.

Do I keep ownership of my account?

Yes. The Google Ads account, Analytics and tracking stay in your name. We work on them with access you control.

Search or Performance Max: which is better?

Search is great for capturing people actively looking for you. Performance Max can add reach across Google. We often start with Search and add others once tracking proves what works.

Will you track calls and WhatsApp leads?

Yes. We set up tracking so calls, forms and WhatsApp enquiries are measured, not just clicks.

Can you guarantee a number of leads?

No, and be careful of anyone who does. What you get from us is a sound setup, honest optimisation, clear reporting and steady improvement.
